title: Task manager is trembling/bouncing when new apps are opened while using the reversed direction setting
line: With new tasks set to appear on the left, existing task buttons no longer jump left and slide back when a window opens.
explanation: Each task button animates moves by comparing its new x with its old x and translating the difference away. With 'new tasks appear on the left' the task list uses a mirrored layout anchored to the right, so adding a task widens the list towards the left: the list itself moves left by one button width and every existing button's x grows by the same amount while staying put on screen. The animation treated that as a move, drew each button one width to the left and slid it back. In a mirrored layout the button now tracks its distance from the list's right edge, so buttons that stay in place don't animate, while real moves (drag reordering, buttons shrinking) still do.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: don't jump task buttons when new tasks appear on the left

With new tasks on the left, the layout is mirrored and grows towards the
left, so every button's x changes when a task is added even though it
stays in place on screen. Track its distance from the right edge instead.

BUG: 499270
